Then "Arábìnrin rẹ̀ jẹ cookies márùn-ún ní ọjọ́ Ajé àti 13 ní ọjọ́ kejì." Means: Her sister ate 5 cookies on Monday and 13 on the next day (Tuesday). So same days. So calculations same.
